//: The dashboard lives in web/, but a Vercel project whose Root Directory is left at the repository root would look for index.html here and serve 404. Pointing outputDirectory at web/ makes the deploy correct either way: with Root Directory unset this file applies, and with Root Directory set to web/ this file is ignored in favour of web/vercel.json, which is kept identical.

headers.//: The dashboard is a single HTML file that changes on every deploy. A request to / never carries the /index.html path, so that rule alone leaves the root cached — both are listed, and the icon is pinned too because a stale favicon reads as a stale app.
